caption: The drawing features a rectangular field with a deep red, diagonally checkered background over which two large brown birds with outstretched wings are centrally positioned, one above the other, both flying horizontally from left to right. Surrounding and partially overlapping the birds are clusters of detailed flowers in shades of pink, white, and red with dark green foliage. The flowers and leaves are arranged primarily along the top, bottom, and right sides of the rectangle, creating an ornate frame-like effect, while additional small floral elements are scattered across the background. The overall composition combines the birds and dense floral patterns against the textured red backdrop, all situated within a larger off-white border.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
